description: `return response as RESPONSE_*` in constants/api/* makes tsc TRUST a hand-written (often wrong) response shape and hides drift — the same lie that ate the v2-home ธาตุ element (chinese-horoscope-get). Closed by PROVABILITY (approach ข), not prettier guesses: (A) endpoints we can hit read-only (chinese-horoscope-get) are typed from the REAL live shape — RESPONSE_CHINESE_HOROSCOPE_GET was rewritten to the verified 15 keys, DELETING the fabricated `analytic.habits_behaviors` and ADDING power/analytic.life/share_profile_url that my-destiny actually reads; (B) endpoints with side effects we refuse to fire (calculate saves a chart; compatibility burns a quota; otp/register/check-line hit LIVE 8x8 SMS / LINE — #184) return `UnverifiedApiResult` ({error?; [k]:unknown}) so callers must narrow, since we must NOT author a type we can't prove. Teeth are type-level (error paths can't be live-tested): neg-control run — revert a narrow (register `typeof result.code==='string'` → `result.code`) → tsc RED (TS2345 '{}' not assignable to SetStateAction<string>); restore → clean, so the honest type surfaces the drift. Real value found (approach ก would have hidden all of these by typing to match the wrong cast): compatibility-WORK was cast to the LOVE response type (system-wide copy-paste); api-otp-get had 2 stray horoscope imports; register `gotoResult(result.code)` had NO null-check ×2 (a real crash if Calculate errors, latent because the blind cast said `.code` always exists). tsc clean · 42/42 tests · zero `as RESPONSE_*` remain. gate_layer=type/static.
